name: Choclair
description: '''Kareem Blake''' (born March 27, 1975), better known by his [[stage name]] '''Choclair''', is a [[Canadians|Canadian]] [[rapping|rapper]]. He was one of the most successful rappers in Canada in the late 1990s and early 2000s. Choclair has been nominated for six [[Juno Awards]], winning four.
